exposure: familial aggregation of Group B Streptococcus (GBS) infection
serotype III CC17 Group B Streptococcus
cohort: The study describes a set of dizygotic twins and a pair of compatriot siblings from two Chinese families, all diagnosed with late-onset Group B Streptococcus meningitis.
finding: There was a dramatic difference in outcomes, with index cases experiencing obvious brain damage and severe sequelae, while their siblings achieved complete healing after prompt diagnosis and anti-infective therapy, highlighting the importance of preventing familial aggregation of neonatal late-onset GBS infection.
